_comment: Locked section vocabulary for one plan's day packages.
It must agree with the plan's `_TEMPLATE.md`; when one changes, change both.
Save it beside the package template, e.g.
Delete every `_comment` key and every placeholder before use.
_top_sections: [key, exact H2 heading text without the 'N. ' prefix, anchor slug], in required order
_challenge_subs: exact H3 heading text -> anchor slug, inside the first H2
_verse_subs: [H4 heading prefix, anchor slug, required?] inside each verse block
_verse_heading_prefix: the H3 prefix that introduces a verse block; the rest of the heading is the verse id
_divergence_prefix: a Divergences heading must START with this word, at H4 or H5
